backend_contract_status: docs/internal/agent-device-association-design-2026-10-17/contract.json absent at research time. Exact schemas/canonical hash framing below follow existing finite research proposal and require shared backend/wire freeze before implementation.
scope: Explicit Device possession/administrative acceptance phase2 only. Fresh same-author Agent manage_identity/browser confirmation phase3 remains separate. Never workload authenticity, activation, enforcement or observed Agent coverage.

command.syntax: gateway accept-agent --custody-file ABS --ca-bundle-file ABS [--timeout 1s..30s] < protected13-field challenge JSON
command.flags: Reuse strict absolute path/closed canonical duration grammar, default10s timeout; forbid endpoint/key/credential/enrollment-token/agent/nonce overrides and positional args. No credential-output flag or implicit activation.
command.input: Bounded maximum4096 exact13-key challenge from stdin; duplicate/null/unknown/casealias/trailing/invalidUTF/surrogate rejection. Non-authorizing challenge still excluded from logs/errors/raw stdout and treated as protected local material. No enrollment token consumed or reused.
command.origin: Original guarded enrollment custody endpoint only; same direct HTTPS explicit CA hostname verification, no proxy, no redirects, no HTTP fallback. LiteralIP allowed only matching certificate IP SAN.
command.flow: Open original custody -> obtain owned original endpoint/request -> strict parse and local scope/device/hash/time checks -> durably retain canonical challenge+exact acceptance bytes before HTTP -> sign fixed POST from protected Store.Sign -> single bounded HTTP request -> strict9-key matching receipt and complete-response time/context checks -> durably retain receipt -> context check -> nonsecret report. Close/join handles then store guard. No key getter.
command.output: Only challenge_id, association_id, agent_id, device_id, original credential_id/generation, state device_acceptance_recorded or device_acceptance_unknown, association_activation pending_human, outcome confirmed only for actual matching persisted phase2 receipt; explicitly does not confirm activation or original enrollment receipt. No nonce/raw challenge/body/signature/private key/token/source evidence dump.
command.unknown: HTTP failure/context failure/invalid response/publication ambiguity returns generic error with device_acceptance_unknown. Retain original intent/key/challenge/body unchanged. No automatic new challenge or key/credential generation replacement.

wire_proposal.package: services/platform/gatewayassociationwire pure standard library; no gatewaycontrol/policy/OPA dependency or widening original enrollment/authority signers.
wire_proposal.challenge_schema: agent-device-intent-v1 as existing research; final backend freeze mandatory.
wire_proposal.challenge_hash: SHA256 canonical first12 members excluding challenge_sha256 in EXACT listed order, UTF8 compact encoding, canonical lowercase IDs/digests and wholeUTC expiry, integer decimal noexponent. Explicit ordered struct/manual shared canonical encoder; never map iteration, GoJSONB textual equivalence or arbitrary re-marshalling. Must freeze cross-language known-answer vector before TDD.
wire_proposal.challenge_validation: Canonical nonzero product IDs; SHA256 lowercase hex64 source/hash; version0..MaxInt64; nonce canonical RawURL32 bytes; expiry wholeUTC and future at send/after full response. Local expiry upperbound alone cannot establish original300s TTL because DTO lacks created_at; server enforces native issuance lifetime. Do not invent client original issue time.
wire_proposal.accept_schema: Unresolved exact schema literal; propose agent-device-acceptance-v1 and freeze with backend. Canonical body built once from validated original challenge, not interactive mutable fields. Exact saved raw body SHA signed/retried.
wire_proposal.path: POST /internal/v1/runtime-gateway/agent-device-associations/accept with emptyquery and exact path; original zasp-runtime-gateway-request-v1 method/host/target/credential/timestamp/rawBodySHA256 signing ABI, Authorization ZaspGatewayV1 <retained credentialID>; verify resulting signature against original request publickey before setting proof headers. Fresh timestamp/signature each retry, identical body/key/credentialID.
wire_proposal.receipt_match: Exact original challenge ID/hash/association/device and retained credentialID/generation; strict schema literal frozen by backend; canonicalUTC<=6fraction accepted_at<=observedAt and expiry=min(original challenge expiry, original credential expiry). Future expiry at complete response and sentAt<=observedAt; do not require accepted_at>=retry sentAt because stable original replay may be earlier. No invented Agent key possession or human authorization.
wire_proposal.response: 200, single exact application/json and no-store, bounded4096, context live after read and after receipt persistence; strict duplicate/null/unknown/alias/trailing/UTF parser. Server exact confirmed same-transaction receipt required; error statuses never translated into proof.

custody_proposal.choice: Add bounded acceptance custody support inside existing guarded gatewayenrollmentcustody, sharing durable publication and existing namespace/export alias checks. New standalone stdlib wire package remains independent. Separate package writing under same key owner without updating exports would miss reserved path/inode checks and is not enough.
custody_proposal.source_helper: Minimal current read access can use BeginRecovery.Source then Close and Store.Sign, with NO Observe/Export and NO currentAuthority claim. Prefer neutral Store.DeviceSource endpoint+ownedSnapshot accessor only if independently frozen; not required just for naming. Enrollment state may be pending or accepted; local stored credential must still be future. Current native server decides actual revocation/generation.
custody_proposal.identity: One immutable intent artifact per canonical challenge_id + fixed original credentialID/generation, containing schema/original enrollment request digest/original endpoint/validated canonical challenge/exact acceptanceRaw/acceptanceSHA256. Separate receipt artifact bound to this full intent; original enrollment bundle/receipt/authority artifacts untouched.
custody_proposal.namespace: Proposed controlled subdirectory .zasp-gateway-enrollment-<basenameSHA>.agent-acceptances with hash-only canonical challenge entries and controlled intent/receipt/stages. Directory creation/ownership/mode/symlink/root-relative publication recovery and bounds must be specified before implementation. Simpler flat names possible only if Open/export enumerate safely and reserve both future names and existing artifacts; do not silently leave wildcard alias gaps.
custody_proposal.durability: Existing exclusive0600 stage -> fsync file+dir -> os.Root.Link nooverwrite -> dirfsync -> only verified sameinode stage cleanup -> dirfsync -> exactreadback, held original guard. On restart reject orphan receipts or malformed/relabelled intent. Recover only own exactsafe stage. Never overwrite/delete history to make retry succeed.
custody_proposal.retry: Same challenge stdin after unknown must produce identical stored canonical body and use same retained key+credentialID+generation with fresh signature timestamp. Any changed challenge or binding under same challengeID conflicts. Exact stored receipt returns historical phase2 result without inventing live availability; expiry/revocation/phase3 status require server/current reads. If expired unknown challenge: stop unknown, operator obtains fresh human phase1 intent; do not alter old bytes or retry expirednonce.
open_questions: Bounded artifact multiplicity/retention: support manyAgentsperDevice without unbounded directory scans or dropping evidence. Explicit maximum and rollover policy required.

Whether repeat command with saved matching receipt returns historical accepted receipt without HTTP or performs fresh signed idempotent server read; choose explicit report semantics. Prefer live replay while unexpired, historical only marked historical.
Final custody typed APIs and namespace shape must be frozen jointly; do not add accidental offline current-authority capability.
Alias protection must cover stages/lock/subdirectory/receipt plus hardlinks across parents and all existing receipt/recovery credential exports.

server_dependencies: Actual signed device auth + current samepool own transaction must bind exactscope/device/current credentialID+generation+expiry, original challenge/nonce/hash/source identity/currentAgent, and final DBclock. Device acceptance never activates. Human phase3 requires NEW fresh current same-author browser Agent authorization; no reuse of human phase1 context or inferred grants.
grouped_tests: Pure wire canonical cross-language hash knownanswer, strict13/8/9 DTO and fixed signedPOST exactbody binding plus wrongscope/hash/nonce/expired refusals.
Custody intent durable before HTTP, exact unknown retry across restart, immutable receipt/original evidence, controlled namespace/aliases/orphans and multiAgent bounded retention.
ActualCLI TLS phase2 success/unknown exactretry/expired and mismatched refusal; output cannot claim active association or Agentcoverage and no secrets; existing enroll/recover/export regression.
no_execution_or_completion: Only read-only source research and this /tmp proposal write. No application edits, tests, Go/Node/native/network/Git execution, permission grants, ledger promotions or milestone completion.

existing_deployed_credential_lane.original_requirement: Existing deployed gateway/Device credentials remain an original remaining requirement. Runtime accepts protected canonical3-field credential JSON credential_id/key_id/private_key; it may exist without enrollment custody, and custody was not transferred from older deployments.
existing_deployed_credential_lane.minimal_batch: Fresh-launch custody flow only. Do not retire existing runtime credential loading/manual gateway behavior or claim allDevice admission covered. No migration/rekey/backfill or fabricated original enrollment intent.
existing_deployed_credential_lane.remaining_adapter: A separately reviewed existing-credential-file adapter would need protected exact3-field0600 key import, explicitly configured trusted origin/CA, live signed Authority to establish actualscope/device/gen/expiry/publickey and fresh current confirmation, then own acceptance custody. It must not fabricate old enrollment request/receipt, infergen from localJSON or import enrollmentcustody by inventing token material. It is not included in this minimal proposal.
